Presentation decriminalized in 2013, embedded third-gender tradition holding chiefly titles, tolerant society, Pride 2026, hate-crime sentencing uplift; dead-letter sodomy statute, thin visitor-facing recourse, and uncorroborated tolerance claim hold it below protection-rich tiers.

Declaration-based recognition, discrimination ban covering goods and services, hate-crime aggravation, marriage equality, prison placement by case-by-case identity with chosen forms of address honored; gaps limited to nonbinary markers, gender-expression ground, under-reporting.
